1. (Currently Amended) A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body having a polygonal cross-section, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, and an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member.

2. (Original) The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open.

5. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said light emitting diodes are arranged in a non-radial pattern around the columnar body.

7. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section with the arrangement of said diodes differing from Chang.

10. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 9 wherein a single diode resides on each face.

11. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 120 W/mK.

13. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises an Edison screw base or a wedge base and the base member is configured differently than that taught in Chang.

16. (Currently Amended) A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 120 W/mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, a light emitting diode mounted to each side of said body, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, said lamp having a general A19 outline which differs in arrangement and configuration from Chang.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said body includes a plurality of integral radially extending fins having a configuration differing from that of Chang.
